question: Which Indian sprinter made a successful comeback by winning a silver medal in the women's 4×100m relay at the 2025 Asian Athletics Championships?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Srabani Nanda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Srabani Nanda** is an accomplished Indian sprinter who specializes in short-distance track events, particularly the 100m and 200m sprints. She has been a part of various national and international competitions, representing India in athletics.
 
• At the **2025 Asian Athletics Championships**, Srabani Nanda made a significant contribution to the women’s 4×100m relay team by winning a silver medal. This marked her successful comeback to competitive athletics after a hiatus.
 
• Her performance is a testament to her resilience and dedication, showcasing her ability to compete at the highest level despite challenges. *Hence, Srabani Nanda is the correct answer.*
 
• The women’s 4×100m relay event is a team-based sprinting competition where four athletes run equal distances while passing a baton. Srabani’s contribution to this event was crucial for India’s success in securing the silver medal.
 
• Her achievement also highlights India’s growing prominence in track and field events at the continental level. It serves as an inspiration for young athletes aspiring to excel in sports. *Hence, her comeback is significant.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Srabani Nanda:**

 
 
• Born on **May 15, 1991**, in Odisha, India, Srabani Nanda is a prominent Indian sprinter. She has represented India in multiple international events, including the **Commonwealth Games**, **Asian Games**, and **World Athletics Championships**.
 
• Her primary events are the **100m** and **200m sprints**, where she has consistently delivered impressive performances. She is also a key member of India’s relay teams.
 
 
 
• **Asian Athletics Championships:**
 
 
• The **Asian Athletics Championships** is a biennial event organized by the **Asian Athletics Association**. It serves as a platform for athletes across Asia to showcase their talent in track and field events.
 
• India has been a consistent performer in this championship, with athletes excelling in various events, including sprints, jumps, and throws.
 
 
 
• **Importance of the 4×100m Relay:**
 
 
• The 4×100m relay is a team event where four athletes run equal distances. The baton exchange is a critical component of the event, requiring precision and coordination.
 
• India’s performance in this event highlights the country’s growing capabilities in short-distance track events on the international stage.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Key Athletes in the Event:**

 
 
• **Hima Das:** Known as the “Dhing Express,” Hima Das is another prominent Indian sprinter specializing in the 400m sprint. However, she did not participate in the 2025 Asian Athletics Championships relay team.
 
• **Dhanalakshmi Sekar:** An emerging sprinter in Indian athletics, Dhanalakshmi is known for her performances in the 100m and 200m sprints. She was not part of the relay team in this event.
 
• **Dutee Chand:** A celebrated Indian athlete specializing in the 100m and 200m sprints, Dutee Chand has represented India in numerous international events. However, she did not feature in the 2025 relay team.
 
 
 
• **Relay Strategy and Training:**
 
 
• Relay races require rigorous training, focusing on baton exchange, speed, and coordination among team members. The success of the Indian team in the 2025 Asian Athletics Championships underscores their preparation and teamwork.
